RiskMap: Geostatistical Modeling of Spatially Referenced Data

Source: R/RiskMap-package.R
RiskMap-package.Rd

Geostatistical analysis of continuous and count point data. Implements stationary Gaussian processes with Matérn correlation for spatial prediction, as described in Diggle and Giorgi (2019, ISBN: 978-1-138-06102-7). An accompanying book by Giorgi and Fronterre describes how the package can be used for model-based geostatistics in public health: https://www.mbgr.org/. It is a successor to 'PrevMap'.
